summary: The Engrave and Vcarve task panels now accept base geometry that is not part of the Job's Model group, removing the "is not a Base Model object of the job" rejection so imported SVG or other document objects can be used directly.

pages.reason: Path/Op/Gui/Engrave.py addBaseGeometry: drops the job.Proxy.resourceClone check, so Base Geometry in the task panel accepts any selected object, not only Job Model members

Path/Op/Gui/Vcarve.py addBaseGeometry: drops the job.Proxy.resourceClone check, so shapes outside the Job Model can be added as Base Geometry; 'Prepare the shapes to engrave' guidance about adding shapes to the Job no longer required

meta.title: CAM: Engrave - Allow to select shape outside the Job
